statements.text: According to G.O.Ms.No.31, the competent authority for transfers of Section Officers and below in the Secretariat Departments is the Secretary to Government of the Department concerned.
statements.quote: The competent authority for transfers of Section Officers and below in the Secretariat Departments shall be the Secretary to Government of the Department concerned

statements.text: Under the superseded G.O.Ms.No.88, the competent authority for transfers of Section Officers and below in the Secretariat Departments was also the Secretary to Government of the Department concerned.
statements.quote: The competent authority for transfers of Section Officers and below in the Secretariat Departments shall be the Secretary to Government of the Department concerned
